raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pymeshlab
  version: "2025.7.post1"
  build_number: 8

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/PyMeshLab/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: e4df9d2b16682b4c05ba4e2519592892d1be1c769fbad5272ce0ec837d27299a
  - url: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/meshlab/archive/dc48b91ae562756a6988048c5d5c7f1d2b687256.tar.gz
    sha256: bac9cc42614ab5318f4c571a6d28eac7c1bfde69b601f9781d3e118d5a054da0
    target_directory: src/meshlab
    patches:
      - patches/0001-use-system-lib3mf.patch
  - url: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/vcglib/archive/c94ef4e12e9ea3ae986d9af91005be8328d13719.tar.gz
    sha256: 346ff5386be9454fc6b70552d6e397c3d82efd3f8097bf06704c7a44ba3296d5
    target_directory: src/meshlab/src/vcglib
  - url: https://github.com/pybind/pybind11/archive/refs/tags/v2.13.6.tar.gz
    sha256: e08cb87f4773da97fa7b5f035de8763abc656d87d5773e62f6da0587d1f0ec20
    target_directory: src/pymeshlab/pybind11
  # MeshLab 2025.07 pins LibIGL 2.4.0 and consumes it from this exact path.
  - url: https://github.com/libigl/libigl/archive/refs/tags/v2.4.0.tar.gz
    sha256: f3f53ee6f1e9a6c529378c6b0439cd2cfc0e30b2178b483fe6bea169ce6deb22
    target_directory: src/meshlab/src/external/downloads/libigl-2.4.0

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - win and match(python, ">3.10")
  script:
    file: ${{ "build.bat" if win else "build.sh" }}
  dynamic_linking:
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - if: win
        then:
          - "*/external-glew.dll"
          - "*/external-lib3ds.dll"
          - "*/IDTF.dll"
          - "*/meshlab-common.dll"
requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake <4
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - make
    - ninja
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: unix
      then: rsync
  host:
    - cgal-cpp
    - eigen
    - if: not ppc64le
      then: embree
    - glew
    - gmp
    - if: not ppc64le
      then: lib3mf
    - libboost-devel
    - libcurl
    - if: linux
      then:
        - libgl-devel
        - libglu
        - libgomp
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - mpfr
    - muparser
    - qhull
    - pip
    - python
    - qt-main
    - setuptools
    - tbb-devel
    - wheel
    - xerces-c
  run:
    - numpy
    - if: not ppc64le
      then: lib3mf
    - if: linux
      then: libglu
    - python
    - if: win
      then:
        - qt-main
        - tbb
        - vcomp14
tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pymeshlab
      pip_check: false
  - files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python
    script:
      - pip list
      - python run_test.py
      - if: not win
        then: pip check

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/PyMeshLab
  summary: The open source mesh processing python library
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: pymeshlab
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
